planningLostReply.limitation: Completed native reply lost before local finish. Process death during a running native turn and absent turn-ID recovery are not qualified.

actualReviewReadback.limitation: Simulated lost local receipt in an isolated online copy; reads original completed real Nims review, not a live process-kill test.

guards: Exact saved task/send/thread/turn and original user payload
Completed turn with bounded final text; supported local item types and successful command execution only
Admission before and after native read; exact CAS and concurrent dedup
No replacement turn, thread resume or automatic approval
Blocked, absent identity, unavailable/incomplete/denied native evidence stays held
limitations: No recovery when turn ID was never saved
Failed or unsupported native tool traces remain unresolved; no permission-denial state is inferred away
